info.title: Dashboard Plus Helper API v1 (draft)
info.description: Local, bearer-only API for granted modules. Helpers may look or suggest new rows; a person decides on Review. Private, system and derived fields are not shared or assignable. This describes the plan before the skeleton is merged; see NOTES.md for provisional response envelopes.

port.description: Current ephemeral local port shown in Settings → Helpers. Never hard-code the example port.

post.summary: Suggest new records for household review
post.description: Requires suggest access. Never changes live module records before a person accepts. Exact retries return 200 and the same batch. Body at most 65536 bytes. Any Origin header is refused.
